deletionRefusals.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
deletionRefusals.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

export.failed: The export could not be prepared. Please try again.

security.title: Security
security.pendingEmail: Awaiting confirmation: {email} (open the link sent by email)

password.title: Password
password.newHint: 12 characters minimum. Your other sessions and trusted devices will be revoked.
password.addIntro: Add a password to also sign in with your email. A verification code will be sent to you by email at each sign-in.
password.emailHint: We'll send you a link to confirm it.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been closed.
password.pending: If this address can be used, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. Your password will work once the address is confirmed.
password.already: This account already has a password.

devices.title: Trusted devices
devices.intro: On these devices, signing in with a password does not ask for a code for 30 days.
devices.dates: Added on {added} · last used {used} · expires on {expires}

connections.title: Connections
connections.lockNote: Keep at least one sign-in method active.
connections.unlinkMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with this account. Your other sessions will be closed. Your Don't Stay Rooky data stays saved.
connections.lastMethod: This is your only sign-in method: it cannot be removed.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.intro: Used to compute your activity days and Woodpecker deadlines. Days already recorded do not change.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.soundsHint: Moves, end of puzzle, module and session
preferences.publicHint: Other players will be able to see your level and your stats.
preferences.privateHint: Your level and your stats are only visible to you.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Automatic follows your device's setting. Your choice is stored on your account and applies to your other devices.

tour.title: Guided tour
tour.againHint: Albert, Aaron, Lizy and their modules, in two minutes.

data.title: Data
data.exportHint: Puzzles, repertoires, sessions and stats · ZIP (JSON + PGN)

push.title: Browser notifications
push.hint: To receive reminders of your sessions and your streak on this device, even when Don't Stay Rooky is closed. Enable it on each device.

streakReminder.title: Streak reminder
streakReminder.hint: In the evening, if you haven't played yet, a notification warns you that your streak ends at midnight.
streakReminder.devices: The notification arrives on the devices where you enabled browser notifications.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: A private address to add to your calendar (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook…): it shows your sessions marked “Add to my calendar” and follows their changes. Keep it to yourself: anyone who knows it can see your sessions.
calendar.howTo: Google Calendar: “Other calendars” → “From URL”. On Apple or Outlook, the “Subscribe” button opens the app.
calendar.regenerateMessage: The current address will stop working: you'll need to add the new one to your calendar.
calendar.revokeMessage: The address will stop working and your calendar will no longer show your sessions.
calendar.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the address to copy it.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.taken: This username was just taken: choose another one.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.erased: The following will be permanently erased:

items.puzzles: your rating, your puzzles and your Woodpecker sets;
items.profile: your profile and your linked accounts.

deletion.frozen: Your account will be {frozen}: you will be signed out everywhere, and can cancel by signing in again. After that, the deletion is permanent.
deletion.exportFirst: Remember to export your data first (“Export” button).
deletion.understood: I understand that my data will be deleted
deletion.codeSent: A 6-digit code has just been sent to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
deletion.recent: Your account has no email address: your recent sign-in is enough to confirm.
deletion.relogin: Your account has no email address: to confirm, sign in again (with Lichess), then come back to delete your account from your profile within 10 minutes.
